matt_support: Heads-up — customer (acme-corp) escalated a p99 latency spike after today's int8 calibration rollout. Ticket #4321 has traces and a sample payload.
jenna_ml: Seeing same on staging. p95's fine but p99 jumps ~250ms on long prompts. Might be KV cache thrash.
ivan_infra: Any infra/drivers changed today? GPUs, cuda, or runtime images?
jenna_ml: No infra changes. Only promoted new calib profile for int8 (calib_v3). I can repro locally with long-seq test.
matt_support: Customer repro: model=redwood-large-quant, quant_profile=int8, seq=2048. They send 2-3 requests, p99 spikes on subsequent calls.
sara_sre: Can you paste an exact curl so we can reproduce quickly in support infra?
jenna_ml: Sure:
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-large-quant\",\"input\":\"<long prompt>\",\"max_tokens\":512,\"quant_profile\":\"int8\"}'
```
jenna_ml: On my laptop p99 goes from ~180ms -> ~430ms, kv miss rate jumps. Kernel selection falls back to slower matmul path for certain block sizes.
ivan_infra: Can you paste perf log snippet?
jenna_ml: Perf excerpt:
```
[perf] seq=2048 tokens=512 kernel=matmul_generic time_ms=412
[kv] miss_rate=0.54 cache_hits=46%
```
matt_support: Customer wants a mitigation asap — what's the fastest safe toggle?
jenna_ml: Short-term options: 1) switch them to fp8 profile (quant_profile=fp8) if accuracy acceptable, 2) force fp16 fallback for that tenant (avoid int8 execution path). Both are config changes, no model recompile.
sara_sre: How do we force per-tenant fp16 fallback?
ivan_infra: We have per-route overrides. Example in routes.yaml:
```
- route: /v1/generate
  tenant: acme-corp
  override:
    model_params:
      quant_profile: fp16
    runtime_flags:
      allow_fp16_fallback: true
```
ivan_infra: I can apply that override for acme-corp now.
opsbot: deploy request queued: route-override/acme-fp16 by ivan_infra
opsbot: deploy succeeded in 3m12s
matt_support: Customer confirmed p99 returned to baseline after fp16 override :thumbsup:
jenna_ml: Long-term: calibration process needs sequence-length-aware profiling. Current calib_v3 picked block sizes that trigger generic matmul for seq > 1024. I'll open a PR to: mark calib_v3 as suspect, add a canary that measures p99 for seq buckets, and revert kernel hints where needed.
sara_sre: Also add alerting: when a calib promotion increases kv miss_rate > 10% for seq>1024, fail the rollout automatically.
jenna_ml: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/5678 — includes repro script and perf traces.
matt_support: Great. I'll update ticket #4321 with the mitigation steps (fp8 suggestion + fp16 override) and note the rollback path.
ivan_infra: Follow-up: scheduled a canary rollback window tomorrow 10:00 UTC if QA sees regressions.
matt_support: Thanks everyone — please ping here when PR merges or if we need to extend the override.
jenna_ml: Will post artifacts (calib diffs, perf graphs) in the ticket later today.
